page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Catchword at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: judicium ferrent, nihil interim ex sa-cris Literis, nihil ex conciliis, nihil ex prifcis patribus proferentes, sed vanas dumtaxat invalidasque ratiunculas. Morinus cui iam pridem genus illud Theologorum displicebat, qui plura passim in suis Libris definire ausi sunt, quae extra salutis dispendium ignorari poterant, vel in dubio relinqui, Hol-stenii sententiam suffragio suo compro-bavit, eamque multis & gravissimis ar-gumentis confirmavit; quippe per il-lud omne tempus, quo Romae otiosus, nec dum in Theologorum Congregatio-nem admissus vixerat, animum suum ad illas applicuerat, quaestiones, quae tunc in his locis illustrabantur. Itaque com-pluribus ostendit Morinus, de Orientalis Ecclesiae ritibus judicium ferendum non esse ex hodierna Ecclesiae Romanae praxi, neque etiam ex Doctrina Theologorum Scholasticorum, qui minus constantes in iis tractandis, quae ad sacramenta perti-nent, nihil omnino habeant inter se con-cordiae: verum ad illa recurrendum esse

page.notes: The left edge carries heavy stains and show-through from the other side; these are not printed text. Some letters in the running head and the first lines are slightly blurred but legible. The printed "JOH, MORINI." is read as "JOH. MORINI."; the comma-like mark after JOH may be a full stop.
